```sql
WITH RECURSIVE product_paths(
    product_id,
    part_id,
    kind,
    unit_cost_cents,
    path_qty,
    depth
) AS (
    SELECT
        p.part_id,
        p.part_id,
        p.kind,
        p.unit_cost_cents,
        1,
        0
    FROM parts AS p
    WHERE p.kind = 'product'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        pp.product_id,
        c.part_id,
        c.kind,
        c.unit_cost_cents,
        pp.path_qty * b.qty,
        pp.depth + 1
    FROM product_paths AS pp
    JOIN bom AS b
        ON b.parent_id = pp.part_id
       AND b.active = 1
    JOIN parts AS c
        ON c.part_id = b.child_id
    WHERE pp.kind <> 'purchased'
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'purchased' THEN part_id END) AS purchased_parts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'purchased' AND unit_cost_cents IS NULL THEN part_id END) AS unpriced_parts,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'purchased' THEN path_qty * COALESCE(unit_cost_cents, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_cost_cents,
    MAX(depth) AS max_depth
FROM product_paths
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY total_cost_cents DESC, product_id ASC;
```

)
